shortFixture.scope: Isolated native WPF host with local test Node CLI; no real application launch or accessibility tree scan. A short soak does not prove absence of a long-term leak.

checks: Background effects pause and hide; foreground resumes without reapplying the image
Sunlight surface bounded to viewport dimensions
Theme restore removes focus listeners, DOM markers, pending callbacks and effects
DOM count remains bounded after repeated apply/restore and GC
renderer.scope: Isolated small-image browser fixture; not a guarantee about GPU drivers or long running production chats

checks: Concurrent status requests do not spawn a process per request
Invalid opening executable stops readiness polling; no UI or default application is invoked

physicalEscapeTest: earlier run blocked by Windows focus restrictions

nativeActivity.foreground: Animate while native managed window or its owned dialog is foreground; ignore document blur
nativeActivity.background: Cancel animations, detach and clear decorative DOM; preserve wallpaper
nativeActivity.wallpaper: Single static wallpaper; no duplicate scaled animated image

roleAnimation.pose: yaw, pitch, roll, side holds and neutral return; static reused arm
roleAnimation.projection: image-driven 2.5D ellipsoid, not redrawn side views
roleAnimation.confirmationAsset: paired inward-facing V signs beside own cheeks
roleAnimation.scope: latest active local log, not selected UI conversation
roleAnimation.protectionScope: eyes and central chin; fingertips may touch side cheeks

quotaInteraction.bubbleVisibility: rings hidden until bubble closing animation completes

nativeControl.scope: Isolated own window and fake local service; excludes Node, pet and real application. Not a long-term performance claim.

normal.scope: Isolated fake local service and own native control window; 30 window open/close cycles, preview file unlocking and disposal, two pet actions, no real application or account CLI launched. Short idle sample is not long-term performance proof.

missing.scope: Isolated fake local service and own native control window; 30 window open/close cycles, preview file unlocking and disposal, two pet actions, no real application or account CLI launched. Short idle sample is not long-term performance proof.

userMaterialWorkflow.scope: Synthetic local images and generated short test clips, full material generation, integrity checks, import, native compilation and waiting overlay rendering. No model, real application or account CLI was launched.
userMaterialWorkflow.aiImageRequirement: Installer session must provide image generation, or user supplies six plates; model access is not bundled.

nativeControlWithGeneratedMaterials.scope: Isolated fake local service and own native control window; 30 window open/close cycles, preview file unlocking and disposal, two pet actions, no real application or account CLI launched. Short idle sample is not long-term performance proof.

orphanedDebugPort.scope: Mock bridge and own loopback fixtures; no real app launched during automated tests.

petVisibilityRecovery.scope: Host selection/receipt fixtures, real HWND helper compilation, isolated WPF frame release and native control fixture. No real application or account CLI launched by tests.

startupPerformance.scope: One local comparison, no real app relaunched. Pet measurement excludes worker/network, frame decoding and host readiness delay; not a whole cold-start guarantee.

nativeTcpTest.scope: Own short-lived loopback listeners only; no application launch or remote connection.
